references.notes: Translated as non-controlled waste left at the dump (Mise en décharge - Décharge non contrôlée): 2,362,925 t. Treatment proportions only reported in source for 'urban MSW' (not for rural). Total urban MSW treated is 6,894,636 t and this was assumed to be 96% of MSW that is collected (total urban MSW generated was then calculated to be 7,181,913 t). Therefore, the calculation to get the open dump percentage is: (2,362,925/7,181,913)*100. Does not accurately reflect treatment in rural areas.
